summary: The same noun can designate the lot used to reach a decision and the share that decision gives a person. The second use explains the reference to inheritance in Psalm 16.

senses.gloss: lot cast to decide a matter
senses.definition: Aaron casts lots over the two goats. In Jonah the sailors cast lots to identify the person connected with the storm.
Land is distributed by lot according to the ancestral tribes. The lot may therefore mean the resulting share: in Psalm 16 Yahweh holds the speaker’s lot secure.

evidence.locator: Leviticus 16:8, the lots placed on the goats

note: A derivation from a word for a pebble has been suggested, but the biblical texts do not specify the material of the lots. The written form in Proverbs 19:19 has a different context and an uncertain reading.
